ruleset.name: cloudlib-pmd
ruleset.description: CloudLib PMD 7 gate (error ruleset). A violation fails `pmdMain`. Derived from pmd-evidence/style-extraction/_catalog.md and, for the S/A picks, from lint-tools-research/05-pmd-sweep.md; the warnings layer lives in pmd/cloudlib-warnings.xml and runs as `pmdAdvisory`.

rule.name: ConstantNaming
rule.message: Constant names must be lowerCamelCase
rule.description: An explicitly `static final` field must match `constantPattern` and an enum constant must match `enumConstantPattern`; fields declared inside an interface are exempt. Single-letter upper-case constants such as `H` are reported.

rule.name: ImportOrder
rule.message: Imports must be grouped (other types, java./javax., static) and sorted inside each group
rule.description: Imports must appear in three ranks — non-`java.`/`javax.` non-static first, then `java.`/`javax.`, then static — and each rank must be strictly increasing by fully qualified name (`import static a.b.*` belongs to the static rank and is legal).

rule.name: NoFullyQualifiedNames
rule.message: Use an import plus the simple name instead of a fully qualified type name
rule.description: Reports dotted type references in code. Import and package declarations, javadoc, string literals, `package-info.java`, uses that disambiguate an imported or declared same-named type, and lines with `// fqn-ok` are exempt.

rule.name: PackageNullMarked
rule.message: A package-info.java must be annotated with @NullMarked
rule.description: A compilation unit that declares no type must carry @NullMarked, written as `@org.jspecify.annotations.NullMarked` or as an import plus `@NullMarked`.

rule.name: SwitchArrowOnly
rule.message: Use an arrow switch branch; `case X:` and `default:` are not allowed
rule.description: Reports every colon-style switch branch. Arrow branches (`case X ->` / `default ->`) are the only accepted form, in both statement and expression switches.

rule.name: BannedNullabilityAnnotation
rule.message: Use JSpecify @Nullable; @NotNull/@Nonnull/@NonNull/@CheckForNull are banned
rule.description: Reports the annotations NotNull, Nonnull, NonNull and CheckForNull. @Nullable is allowed.

rule.name: PublicNonFinalInstanceField
rule.message: A public field must be final; use an accessor for mutable state
rule.description: Reports public instance fields that are not final. The `dev.vfyjxf.cloudlib.api.math` package is exempt (deliberately mutable geometry values).

rule.name: IllegalImport
rule.message: Import a JSpecify annotation instead of this one
rule.description: Catalogue C-25. Bans the imports javax.annotation.Nullable, javax.annotation.Nonnull, javax.annotation.CheckForNull, org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable and org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull.

rule.name: CjkText
rule.message: Source files must not contain CJK text
rule.description: Catalogue C-26. Reports every line of a source file that contains a CJK Unified Ideograph (U+4E00..U+9FFF). A custom rule because PMD 7 removed RegexpSinglelineJava.

rule.name: MustCallSuperOnAnnotatedOverride
rule.message: An override of a @MustBeInvokedByOverriders method must call super of it
rule.description: Reports an @Override of tick(), collectInspectionInfo() or init() declared on a subtype of Widget, CompositeWidget, WidgetGroup, BasicScreen or BasicMenuScreen whose body never calls super of the same method. The annotated (superclass, method) pairs are the rule's `annotatedMethods` property. Catalogue A-01.

rule.name: LangKeyAsLiteralText
rule.message: A LangEntry raw exit went into a slot that wants the other kind of string
rule.description: Reports a LangEntry key given where literal text is wanted (RichText.of, Builder.text, KVRowWidget.of(String, ...), setText/setLabel/setTitle(String), TextFieldWidget.setPlaceholder, SectionHeaderWidget.of) and a LangEntry translated value given where a key is wanted (KeyMapping, OptionSpec, Component.translatable, Builder.translatable, LangFile.add, Map#get). Catalogue A-02.

rule.name: PluginMarkerClassShape
rule.message: @PluginMarker classes must be instantiable by AnnotationPluginLookup
rule.description: A class annotated @PluginMarker must implement a ModPlugin subtype, must be public with a public no-argument constructor (declaring none is fine), must be static when nested and must not be abstract; a concrete ModPlugin subtype without the marker is reported as well. The `exemptClasses` property lists the hand-injected entry-point plugins. Catalogue A-03.

rule.name: NoMountedAccessorInLifecycleListener
rule.message: A lifecycle listener reads a mounted-gate accessor of its own widget
rule.description: Reports an unqualified call to scene(), context(), path(), layout(), applyLayout() or needsLayout() on the enclosing widget from inside an onInit/onMount/onUnmount/onDestroy listener body. Catalogue A-04.

rule.name: RegisterHandleMustNotEscape
rule.message: A registration handle must not survive the dispatch it belongs to
rule.description: Reports a *Register-typed parameter stored into a field, assigned to a field access, or captured by a lambda handed to CompletableFuture/Executor/ForkJoinPool. Catalogue A-05.

rule.name: NoCallToUnimplementedStub
rule.message: This call targets an unimplemented framework stub
rule.description: Reports a call to a public framework API that only throws UnsupportedOperationException. The `stubs` property holds the owner/method pairs; the two current entries are Widget#setDraggable and Widgets#grid. Catalogue A-06.

rule.name: ReceiveHookUsesApply
rule.message: A receive hook must apply, not set or load
rule.description: Reports a method reference or lambda passed to whenReceive/whenReceiveFromClient that calls Handle.set or Handle.load. handle::apply is the correct receive path. Catalogue A-07.

rule.name: SerializeLoadsSilently
rule.message: Serialize.create with a Handle must use the Handle overload, not a setter
rule.description: Reports a four-argument Serialize.create whose third argument is a Handle::set or Handle::apply, or a lambda doing the same; use the (name, Handle, Codec) overload instead. Catalogue A-08.

rule.name: ListenerUnregisterIdentity
rule.message: The event layer identifies listeners by reference, and this call cannot match
rule.description: Reports an inline lambda, method reference or `new` expression passed to unregister/ isRegistered on the event layer, and an unregister of a raw listener that registerManaged(listener, int) already wrapped. Catalogue A-09.

rule.name: EventDefinitionMustBeEvaluatedOnce
rule.message: An event definition must be evaluated once, in a field initializer
rule.description: Reports Events.define(...), Events.createGeneric(...), Event.create(...) and SimpleEvent.create(...) evaluated inside a method, constructor or lambda body instead of a field initialiser. Catalogue A-10.

rule.name: ExposeIdMustComeFromNextId
rule.message: An Expose id must come from management.nextId(), not a written constant
rule.description: Reports a call to Expose.create, LayerExpose.create, ReversedOnly.create or UnaryReversed.create whose second argument is a written literal (a cast literal counts). Catalogue B-01.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'create'] [ArgumentList/*[2][self::StringLiteral or self::NumericLiteral or self::BooleanLiteral or self::CharLiteral or self::NullLiteral or self::CastExpression[NumericLiteral or CharLiteral or StringLiteral or BooleanLiteral]]] [pmd-java:typeIs('dev.vfyjxf.cloudlib.api.network.expose.Expose') or pmd-java:typeIs('dev.vfyjxf.cloudlib.api.network.expose.LayerExpose') or pmd-java:typeIs('dev.vfyjxf.cloudlib.api.network.expose.ReversedOnly') or pmd-java:typeIs('dev.vfyjxf.cloudlib.api.network.expose.UnaryReversed')]

rule.name: StyleVarNameHasCustomPropertyPrefix
rule.message: A StyleVar name must start with `--` (it is a CSS custom property)
rule.description: Reports a StyleVar factory call (of/color/number/integer/bool/ident/tokens/texture) whose literal first argument does not start with `--`. Catalogue B-02.

rule.name: AttributeKeySharedConstant
rule.message: An AttributeKey must be a static final constant shared by both sides
rule.description: Reports AttributeKey.of(...) outside a static final field initialiser: the key would compare unequal to every other instance of the same name. Catalogue B-03.

rule.name: NamespaceLiteralMustUseConstants
rule.message: A namespace argument must come from Constants/CloudNamespaces, not a literal
rule.description: Reports ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath, `new ResourceLocation`, Namespace.of and `new InworldGroup` given a written namespace other than `minecraft` or `c`. Catalogue B-04.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'fromNamespaceAndPath'] [pmd-java:typeIs('net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation')] [ArgumentList/*[1][self::StringLiteral][not(@ConstValue = 'minecraft') and not(@ConstValue = 'c')]] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'of'] [pmd-java:typeIs('dev.vfyjxf.cloudlib.api.util.Namespace')] [ArgumentList/*[1][self::StringLiteral][not(@ConstValue = 'minecraft') and not(@ConstValue = 'c')]] | //ConstructorCall [pmd-java:typeIs('net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation') or pmd-java:typeIs('dev.vfyjxf.cloudlib.api.ui.inworld.group.InworldGroup')] [ArgumentList/*[1][self::StringLiteral][not(@ConstValue = 'minecraft') and not(@ConstValue = 'c')]]
